center_catch.control: motion file at 0.005 s is input control; native saved pose/angle/omega must be compared at output times
center_catch.opening: finite moving cup-mouth aperture; crossing is interpolated in body coordinates and retains particle ID
center_catch.receiver: finite receiver interior excluding one boundary shell; repeated entry/exit contributes signed net and separate recrossings
center_catch.source: initial Mk layer 0/1/2, continuous z bands from the same initial fluid geometry
center_catch.spill_tray: finite tray interior excluding one boundary shell; spill only after prior cup-mouth departure
center_catch.unknown_mass: initial native mass denominator minus mutually exclusive categories; never relabel as spill

offset_spill.control: motion file at 0.005 s is input control; native saved pose/angle/omega must be compared at output times
offset_spill.opening: finite moving cup-mouth aperture; crossing is interpolated in body coordinates and retains particle ID
offset_spill.receiver: finite receiver interior excluding one boundary shell; repeated entry/exit contributes signed net and separate recrossings
offset_spill.source: initial Mk layer 0/1/2, continuous z bands from the same initial fluid geometry
offset_spill.spill_tray: finite tray interior excluding one boundary shell; spill only after prior cup-mouth departure
offset_spill.unknown_mass: initial native mass denominator minus mutually exclusive categories; never relabel as spill

measurement_rules.boundary: fluid mass excludes fixed or moving wall nodes; physical walls are not an open sink
measurement_rules.first_passage: linearly interpolate bracketed finite-region crossing in native consecutive frames; if not bracketed mark right-censored
measurement_rules.mass: mass-weight every count; use initial fluid IDs only and keep unknown in denominator
measurement_rules.residence: sum native time intervals in each region, retaining repeated receiver/tray/cup occupancy
